policy: Data ancestry including cohort selection and training, not island number or report label. Shared neutral geography alone does not change ownership. External_only is file/source independence, not biological independence. Keep frozen paper files in place; no duplicate claims.

own_gbif.description: Project constructed island-species occurrence roster, not publisher GIFT island checklist.

own_traits.description: Project assembled floral/reproductive evidence ledger, including Direct and eligible All variants; exact scope is result-specific.

external_status.description: Separately attached floristic status ledger; status provenance/quality requires source-specific audit. No replacement of occurrence membership.

own_status_flora.description: Own GBIF roster LEFT joined to status. Classify the status-aware input conservatively as mixed when status used.

own_plant_aggregate.description: Project plant-flora/trait summaries, including public aggregates; public availability does not make the underlying observations independent.

gift_mainland.description: Official GIFT mainland candidate source pool, distinct from focal island incidence.

gift_island.description: Direct official publisher island checklist; NOT historical GIFT4505 target.

gift_traits.description: Official publisher trait values/metadata, not own integrated ledger.

wcvp.description: Regional native compatibility, not exact island nativity.

animal_sources.description: Independent animal source observations/ranges/checklists (specific source varies by test); not measured pollination efficiency.

geography.description: Shared geometry/climate/area/isolation covariates. Neutral ONLY if not selected/calibrated on own botanical observations.

unknown.description: Exact input ancestry unresolved; do not promote as independent.
